Approved findings

Approved evidence · As of 10 Nov 2026

ClawsBench · documents: The paper evaluates a ragged set of model-harness and skills/meta-prompt conditions with five repeats, reporting 7,224 completed main trials after infrastructure losses.

Permanent record ID: candidate.mandatory19.benchmark.clawsbench.experimental-design

  • Source-version-bound creator disclosure; private author-only candidate, with no approved scientific independence, new family coverage or supplier-relationship credit.
  • The 20-task TSR and 24-task safety metrics use different denominators. Partial factorial coverage and repeated trials do not yield independent natural deployment incidents.

Approved evidence · As of 10 Nov 2026

ClawsBench · documents: The paper explicitly limits interpretation because services omit latency, rate limits and concurrent access, there is no human baseline, evaluation is single-shot and the design has incomplete factorial coverage.

Permanent record ID: candidate.mandatory19.benchmark.clawsbench.limits-and-transfer

  • Source-version-bound creator disclosure; private author-only candidate, with no approved scientific independence, new family coverage or supplier-relationship credit.
  • Safety tasks deliberately elicit unsafe actions. Same-task prompt development and limited service coverage do not establish held-out transfer or natural-world incident rates.

Approved evidence · As of 10 Nov 2026

ClawsBench · documents: ClawsBench uses 44 tasks across five mock productivity services, with 20 performance tasks and 24 safety tasks; grading compares service state before and after the attempt.

Permanent record ID: candidate.mandatory19.benchmark.clawsbench.task.and-grading-units

  • Source-version-bound creator disclosure; private author-only candidate, with no approved scientific independence, new family coverage or supplier-relationship credit.
  • The mocks are bounded productivity environments. A task, API route, fixture and trajectory are different units, and no live-service effectiveness is established.
